units.source_text: 总不见公共汽车的影子，公路上渺无人迹。

en.t: No sign of a bus appeared at all, and there was not a soul on the road.

units.source_text: 正法山妙心寺的巨大的南门通将过来。

en.t: The enormous south gate of Shobozan Myoshinji seemed to be coming straight toward me.

units.source_text: 左右两扇大大地敞开的门，仿佛要把所有的现象都统统地吞进去。

en.t: The two great doors, flung wide open to left and right, seemed ready to swallow every phenomenon whole.

units.source_text: 从这里眺望，它那巨大的框架里，并吞了敕使门和山门的位子重复的状况、

en.t: Viewed from here, its huge frame swallowed up the overlapping positions of the Imperial Messenger Gate and the main temple gate,

units.source_text: 佛殿的屋脊瓦、繁多的松树，再加上被鲜明地切开的一部分蓝天，甚至还有几片薄云。

en.t: the roof tiles of the Buddha hall, the many pine trees, and, beyond them, a sharply cut section of blue sky and even a few thin clouds.

units.source_text: 走近大门，可以看见宽阔的寺庙内纵横走向的石板地和许多小庙的墙壁等等无尽的东西也加进其中。

en.t: As one approached the great gate, the stone pavements running lengthwise and crosswise through the broad temple grounds, the walls of many small subtemples, and countless other things could also be seen joining that view.

units.source_text: 然而，一旦跨进门里，就知道这座神秘的大门，在其门内收有苍穹的全部和云彩的全部。

en.t: Yet once one stepped inside the gate, one understood that this mysterious great gate contained within it the whole vault of heaven and all the clouds.

units.source_text: 所谓大寺庙就是这样的玩意儿。

en.t: That is what a so-called great temple is.
